\subsection{Token-matched robustness check}
We compared Search with Best-of-N ($N=8$) using a shared 14,000-token cap across 130 questions and three seeds. Best-of-N achieved mean accuracy of $0.228 \pm 0.022$, compared with $0.151 \pm 0.018$ for Search. Mean token consumption was 12,348 tokens per question for Best-of-N and 11,230 for Search. Thus, both methods shared the same token cap, although their actual token consumption differed. Table~\ref{tab:a7-token-matched} reports the results.
